name: Single-use cards
summary: Stripe's Link wallet for agents issues a one-time-use virtual card (or a Shared Payment Token) for one purchase the user has approved. The agent creates a spend request with amount, merchant and context; the user approves it in Link; the agent never sees the real card.
facts: One-time virtual card, recurring card, Shared Payment Token, Link Pay Token
Per spend request on web or Link app; 30-minute window
goodFor: Agents buying at any card-accepting site
Per-purchase human approval with capped amounts
watchOut: Every purchase still needs a human approval
Card details can leak into transcripts unless written to a file
